question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a yellow present, Bob has a teal present, Claire has a black present, Dave has a brown present, Eve has a blue present, Fred has a green present, and Gertrude has a grey present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Dave has the
Options:
(A) yellow present
(B) teal present
(C) black present
(D) brown present
(E) blue present
(F) green present
(G) grey present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (yellow, teal, black, brown, blue, green, grey)
1. Dave and Eve swap: (yellow, teal, black, blue, brown, green, grey)
2. Dave and Eve swap: (yellow, teal, black, brown, blue, green, grey)
3. Claire and Dave swap: (yellow, teal, brown, black, blue, green, grey)
4. Claire and Bob swap: (yellow, brown, teal, black, blue, green, grey)
5. Claire and Eve swap: (yellow, brown, blue, black, teal, green, grey)
6. Fred and Gertrude swap: (yellow, brown, blue, black, teal, grey, green)
7. Fred and Gertrude swap: (yellow, brown, blue, black, teal, green, grey)
Dave has the black present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
